name: relevance
description: How relevant one item is to the reader's topic keywords, and which topic matched

relevance.instructions: How relevant is the item in `title` and `excerpt` to the topics in `topic_keywords`? Topics with a higher `weight` matter more to the reader. `taste_examples` lists items the reader liked or disliked.
criteria: Core news for a heavily weighted topic

matched_topic.instructions: Which topic in `topic_keywords` is the item in `title` and `excerpt` most about?
